findings.claim: hasFeatureDocument answers true only when fsdoc.Reader.Read succeeds. Read refuses a symlinked document, a non-regular file, one larger than oddtask.MaxDocumentBytes, and one that cannot be opened. Each of those cases returns false, so the seq 1 refusal is skipped and the record is stored. The task rule and the CHANGELOG say the refusal applies when odd/tasks/<G>.md is at the worktree root. A document that exists but cannot be read therefore lets the pre-open record through, which is the L130 duplicate-chain shape this change closes. Only the missing-file and no-repository cases are intended to answer as before. The only test of the false path is the goal with no document.

The inception-pipeline skill still tells the parent to append a chain-entry record (seq 1, goal and chain both equal to the change name) with `labdrian roles append`. The skill was not updated to match this change. When odd/tasks/<change>.md already exists in the checkout, which is possible when the pipeline is re-entered for an existing feature, that documented step now exits 1 and the skill gives no recovery path. TestInceptionChainEntryRecordRunsThroughTheRolesVerbs passes only because its example goal add-wishlist has no document, so no test covers the skill's flow against a feature that already has a document.

The task's tests include a cwd outside a repository answering as before, and the rule reads the document at the worktree root and not at cwd. Neither is tested here. A subdirectory cwd and a no-repository cwd are not covered. Neither are the fail-open reader refusals from F1 (symlinked, oversized or unreadable document).
